items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And my first inspiration back there was the time when John Philip Sousa came in to direct the band

ctx.x: Right, it was around in there. Well, a little more than that, because, let's see, 1912 and then -- let's see, this was '26, about 14, and then I come out of the elementary school there, and then I come back to Chicago and went to Tilden Tech. So I -- and then I went in the band at Tilden Tech. And my first inspiration back there was the time when John Philip Sousa came in to direct the band, and man, that was really a real kick, you know.
And then when they would take us down to Orchestra Hall, and Frederick Stock was the conductor, then, so this is -- that was a little of the background of the music.
